name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: The steps of a task done in order: an ordered list of numbered steps joined by lines, showing done (accent, check), current, upcoming and failed steps, horizontal or vertical, with completed steps optionally clickable to go back.

manifest.name: stepper
manifest.title: Stepper
manifest.description: The steps of a task done in order: an ordered list of numbered steps joined by lines, showing done (accent, check), current, upcoming and failed steps, horizontal or vertical, with completed steps optionally clickable to go back.
manifest.usage: Use Stepper to show where the user is in a task of three to six ordered steps: add a connection, approve access, connect; a first-run guide. Pass steps ({ title, description?, error? }) and value (the current index; steps.length when all are done); pass onValueChange to let the user return to a completed step; name it with aria-label. It shows progress, it does not hold the steps' content: render the current step's form beside it. For a hierarchy use Breadcrumb; for views the user switches freely, Tabs.

props.name: steps
props.type: { title: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; error?: boolean }[]
props.description: The steps, in order; error marks one that failed.

props.name: value
props.description: The current step's index from 0; steps.length when all are done.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Makes completed steps buttons that go back to them.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A row of steps, or a column for a side panel.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The list's accessible name: what the steps are for.

slots.name: indicator
slots.description: The circle (size.control.sm) with the number, a check when done, or an alert mark when failed; aria-hidden; data-slot="stepper-indicator".

slots.name: title
slots.description: The step's name in type.label, with its status as visually hidden text; data-slot="stepper-title".

slots.name: connector
slots.description: The line to the next step, color.accent.bg once the step is done; data-slot="stepper-connector".

slots.name: button
slots.description: Wraps a completed step when onValueChange is given; data-slot="stepper-button".

parts.name: StepperItem
parts.description: One step, an <li> with aria-current="step" when current and data-status; Stepper renders one per step.

states.name: complete
states.description: A step before the current one: accent circle with a check, accent connector.

states.name: current
states.description: The current step: accent ring, aria-current="step".

states.name: upcoming
states.description: A step after the current one: color.border.strong ring, color.fg.muted number and title.

states.name: error
states.description: A step that failed: color.status.danger border, background and text, an alert mark.

states.name: hover
states.description: A clickable completed step under the pointer: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on a clickable step: the focus ring.

accessibility: An ordered list named by aria-label; the current step has aria-current="step".
Each step's status is visually hidden text after its title (completed, current step, not started, failed), so it does not rest on the circle's colour or icon, which are aria-hidden.
With onValueChange, completed steps are buttons in the tab order with a focus ring; upcoming steps are not interactive.
